list_releases.description: List every version a package has published, with the date it went out, how many files it shipped and whether it was a pre-release or has since been withdrawn. Filter to stable versions only, or to a window of dates, to build a changelog or see how often a project ships. No API key required.

list_vulnerabilities.description: List the known security advisories for a package, from the Open Source Vulnerability database PyPI reports from. Ask about a specific version to check something a project has pinned; each advisory says what the issue is, which versions fix it and where to read more. No API key required.

search_projects.description: Find projects whose name contains, starts with, ends with or exactly matches some text. PyPI publishes no full-text search, so this matches names rather than descriptions: it is the step for 'is there a package called something like this?'. Matching ignores capitals and treats '-', '_' and '.' as the same character, exactly as PyPI does. No API key required.

description: Read the Python Package Index from a workflow. Look a package up by name, read its metadata, licence, maintainers and supported Pythons, walk its full release history, and list the wheels and source distributions it ships with their download URLs and checksums. Check whether a dependency has a newer version than the one you pin, list its dependencies and their version ranges, and pull the known security advisories for any version. Watch PyPI's feeds for new releases and newly registered projects, verify which repository built a file from its signed provenance, and search all 900,000+ project names. No account or API key required.
